_note: Things that stand on the overworld (isometric, M4 art pass). 'art': the image in art/locations/out/<art>.png (set pieces converted from the owner's drafts) or a prop drawn by art/tools/iso_map.py. 'wx'/'wy': footprint in tiles along the map's x (down-right on screen) and y (down-left); every footprint tile is solid unless 'walkable'. 'decal': lies flat on the ground (drawn under people). 'door': where you stand to knock (relative to the footprint's top corner; facing the building, A reads 'doorText'). 'opens': facing it and pressing A opens that screen (the sanctuary's CRT stones).

cottage.doorText: Callum's place. Smells like a fry-up and a Scottish summer (rain).

casa.doorText: Dani's place. The door's open. Dani isn't here. Dani is "five minutes away".

suburb.doorText: Nolan's place. The van's still in the driveway. Someone is watching it from a window. With a coffee.

shed.doorText: Haydon's streaming shed. A sign says LIVE, with the V crossed out.
